label: Archives
when: the posts by month or year as a list or a dropdown (a blog archive)
rules: One self-closing comment, no inner blocks. It lists the periods that have published posts, each linking to that period's posts, so never write dates or links. "type" is "monthly" (default), "yearly", "weekly" or "daily". "showPostCounts":true adds the number of posts. "displayAsDropdown":true shows a select instead of a list ("showLabel":false hides its label). A list gets a heading above it, a dropdown does not.
